records.jp: そういえば、こころって普段銃使って戦うじゃん？<CR>やっぱ射的も得意？
records.en_original: Hey, since you use a gun when you fight, are you any good at these shooting games?
records.en: Hey, since you use a gun when you fight, are you any good at these shooting games?

records.jp: まあ、得意な方……だと思うよ
records.en_original: Well, I suppose I'm pretty good.
records.en: Well, I suppose I'm pretty good.

records.jp: 子どもの頃、景品を取りすぎちゃったせいで<CR>屋台に出入り禁止になったこともあったし……
records.en_original: They once banned me from playing for winning too many prizes when I was little.
records.en: They once banned me from playing for winning too many prizes when I was little.

records.jp: 屋台出禁！？
records.en_original: Banned?!
records.en: Banned?!

records.jp: 大人げないなあ、屋台の主人……
records.en_original: Sounds like whoever ran the booth was super lame.
records.en: Sounds like whoever ran the booth was super lame.

records.jp: 屋台のおじさんも最初は景品を倒れにくくしたりして、<CR>対策しようとしてたみたいなんだけど……
records.en_original: At first, I think he just tried to rig the game against me so that the prizes didn't fall as easily.
records.en: At first, I think he just tried to rig the game against me so that the prizes didn't fall as easily.

records.jp: そしたら、今度は他の子が全然取れなくなっちゃって
records.en_original: But then, none of the other kids could win anymore.
records.en: But then, none of the other kids could win anymore.

records.jp: それで、おじさんの方が折れたんだ……
records.en_original: So the owner had to change it back to normal eventually, huh?
records.en: So the owner had to change it back to normal eventually, huh?

records.jp: そのおじさん、お父さんの仕事仲間だったんだけど、<CR>家まで来て頭下げられちゃった
records.en_original: He was actually my dad's coworker. He came by our house to apologize later.
records.en: He was actually my dad's coworker. He came by our house to apologize later.

records.jp: うーん……末恐ろしい子どもだ
records.en_original: Sounds like you were a pretty tough kid.
records.en: Sounds like you were a pretty tough kid.

records.jp: なんかカッコイイね。<CR>西部劇に出てくる伝説のガンマンって感じ？
records.en_original: That's kind of cool. It's like you're one of those outlaws in a western movie.
records.en: That's kind of cool. It's like you're one of those outlaws in a western movie.

records.jp: 学校とかでもウワサになってたんじゃない？
records.en_original: I bet they talked about the girl who beat the shooting booth at school!
records.en: I bet they talked about the girl who beat the shooting booth at school!

records.jp: あー……わたしとは知られずにウワサが広がってたよ。<CR>しかもすごい尾ひれがついて
records.en_original: Ah... There were rumors, but no one knew it was about me. Before I knew it the story was blown way out of proportion.
records.en: Ah... There were rumors, but no one knew it was about me. Before I knew it the story was blown way out of proportion.

records.jp: 一発で十個の景品を撃ち抜いたとか、見た目は子ども<CR>だけど実は伝説のガンマンの生まれ変わりだとか……
records.en_original: Something about a legendary gunman reincarnated into a kid who shot ten prizes with one bullet.
records.en: Something about a legendary gunman reincarnated into a kid who shot ten prizes with one bullet.

records.jp: 本当にあるんだ、そういうこと……
records.en_original: Kids sure have an active imagination...
records.en: Kids sure have an active imagination...

records.jp: もちろん自分からは言い出せなくて、<CR>地元の七不思議みたいになってた……
records.en_original: I couldn't find the time to tell everyone it was me, so it became this kind of local urban legend...
records.en: I couldn't find the time to tell everyone it was me, so it became this kind of local urban legend...

records.jp: それじゃあ、せっかくだし<CR>こころの腕前でも見せてもらおうかな？
records.en_original: Well, since we're here, why don't you show me your skills?
records.en: Well, since we're here, why don't you show me your skills?

records.jp: ふふっ、任せなさい
records.en_original: Hehe. Just you watch.
records.en: Hehe. Just you watch.

records.jp: すご、全弾命中……。<CR>さすが、屋台荒らしのこころ
records.en_original: Wow... Perfect score. You really are the shooting booth outlaw.
records.en: Wow... Perfect score. You really are the shooting booth outlaw.

records.jp: やめてよその呼び方……
records.en_original: Hey, don't call me that...
records.en: Hey, don't call me that...

records.jp: それじゃあ、せっかくだし勝負しよう！
records.en_original: Well, since we're here, let's make this a competition!
records.en: Well, since we're here, let's make this a competition!

records.jp: あー！　当たらないー！
records.en_original: Bah! I can't hit anything!
records.en: Bah! I can't hit anything!

records.jp: はい、わたしの勝ち
records.en_original: Looks like I win.
records.en: Looks like I win.

records.jp: うう……。全然だめだった。<CR>こころはぽんぽん当ててたのに……
records.en_original: Aw... I was terrible. You hit like every single one!
records.en: Aw... I was terrible. You hit like every single one!

records.jp: まあまあ。元気出して。はい、景品のお菓子
records.en_original: There, there, Ao. Here's a snack as your prize.
records.en: There, there, Ao. Here's a snack as your prize.

records.jp: ありがと……。<CR>じゃない！　次は負けないからね！
records.en_original: Thanks... Wait, no! I won't lose next time, you hear!
records.en: Thanks... Wait, no! I won't lose next time, you hear!

records.jp: なんか的を狙うコツとかあるの？<CR>教えてよ、こころ先生！
records.en_original: Please teach my your ways, master!
records.en: Please teach my your ways, master!

records.jp: ふふっ、任せなさい
records.en_original: Hehe. It would be my pleasure.
records.en: Hehe. It would be my pleasure.

records.jp: 構えはこんな感じで……。<CR>脇を絞めて銃をしっかり固定するのがコツ
records.en_original: First, stand like this... Now, tighten your elbows to your sides and hold the gun steady.
records.en: First, stand like this... Now, tighten your elbows to your sides and hold the gun steady.

records.jp: こんな、感じ……？
records.en_original: Like this?
records.en: Like this?

records.jp: そしたら、ほっぺをくっつけて、<CR>銃の先に目線を合わせて……
records.en_original: Then bring your cheek in close and line your sight to the tip of the gun.
records.en: Then bring your cheek in close and line your sight to the tip of the gun.

records.jp: ち、近いよこころ……
records.en_original: Y-you're really close...
records.en: Y-you're really close...

records.jp: あ、ごめん……
records.en_original: Oh, sorry...
records.en: Oh, sorry...

records.jp: あはは……。こんなぐいぐい来るこころ、珍しいね
records.en_original: Hahaha. It's just that you're usually not this assertive.
records.en: Hahaha. It's just that you're usually not this assertive.

records.jp: つい熱くなっちゃって……<CR>はい、アドバイスおわり。撃ってみて
records.en_original: I guess I got a little excited... Well, that's my advice. Give it a shot.
records.en: I guess I got a little excited... Well, that's my advice. Give it a shot.

records.jp: んん……
records.en_original: Mmm...
records.en: Mmm...

records.jp: ちょ、愛央ちゃんくすぐったい……。<CR>そんなくねくねしてたら撃てないよ？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao, that tickles! You won't be able to shoot straight if you squirm around like that.
records.en: Hey, Ao, that tickles! You won't be able to shoot straight if you squirm around like that.

records.jp: あはは、そうだよね……うん
records.en_original: Hahaha, I know. Alright.
records.en: Hahaha, I know. Alright.

records.jp: はい、アドバイスおわり。撃ってみて
records.en_original: Well, that's my advice. Give it a shot.
records.en: Well, that's my advice. Give it a shot.

records.jp: ……いけっ！
records.en_original: Go!
records.en: Go!

records.jp: ……やった！　当たった！
records.en_original: I did it! I hit it!
records.en: I did it! I hit it!

records.jp: お見事！　ぱちぱちぱち
records.en_original: Well done!
records.en: Well done!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
